meta.name: walkthrough-review
meta.description: Record a live browser walkthrough, render a README-quality GIF/MP4, run Gemini video/UI review, fix defects, and update proof docs. Use when a feature needs demo evidence, README media, product walkthrough QA, or a reusable solo-founder verification loop.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 录制浏览器操作并自动生成演示动图和测试报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为功能录制带质检的演示证据
copy.tagline_en: Record browser walkthroughs and auto-generate demo GIFs with QA reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to capture live browser sessions with automated review and proof docs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以录制浏览器操作视频，生成 GIF/MP4，调用 Gemini 进行 UI 评审，修复缺陷，并更新文档。
howto.when: 当用户需要录制产品演示、生成 README 媒体、进行 UI 评审或验证用户体验时触发。

say.text: 帮我录制并评审“启动尽职调查作战室”功能的演示。
say.note: Claude 会执行录制、渲染、评审全流程。

say.text: 对已有的演示视频重新进行 Gemini 评审。
say.note: Claude 会跳过录制，直接调用 Gemini 评审。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can record a browser walkthrough, render a GIF/MP4, run a Gemini video/UI review, fix defects, and update proof documents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs a recorded product demo, README media, UI review, or UX verification loop.

say_en.text: Record and review the 'startup-diligence-war-room' feature walkthrough.
say_en.note: Claude will run the full capture, render, and review pipeline.

say_en.text: Re-judge the existing demo video with Gemini.
say_en.note: Claude will skip capture and directly run Gemini review.
